label: GeBIZ
terms_note: Singapore government; RSS public; supplier registration + Corppass for bids.

reference.verdict: **Verdict** — has_api: **partial** (RSS feed for opportunities and awards). Lane `assist` → **keep**. Confidence high.
auth: 1. None for RSS; Corppass + Trading Partner registration to bid.

endpoints.call: RSS Feed for Opportunities and Award

reference.limits: - Government portal; bids in GeBIZ only. - Singapore government; RSS public; supplier registration + Corppass for bids.

reason: GeBIZ offers no API. Its FAQ (https://www.gebiz.gov.sg/faq.html, opened 2026-09-25) describes an 'RSS Feed for Opportunities and Award' (open tenders/quotations of the last 2 days, grouped by procurement category, refreshed hourly) but publishes no feed URL; the public opportunity pages (/ptn/opportunity/BOListing.xhtml) link none, and /ptn/rss/index.xhtml redirects to /ptn/accessDenied.xhtml. The runtime could now parse the RSS, but there is no documented, publicly reachable feed address. Missing: a public GeBIZ feed URL. Bids require Corppass + GeBIZ Trading Partner registration.
